title: EV Charger Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install one seven-kilowatt (7kW) single-phase EV charger (e.g., Wallbox Pulsar Plus) at a residential property in Brunswick East, Melbourne. This includes a new dedicated twenty-two-metre run of six-millimetre two-core-and-earth TPS cable from the main switchboard to the garage, installed largely concealed within wall cavities, with three metres of surface-mounted heavy-duty grey conduit for the final external run to the charger location. Installation of one new thirty-two-amp circuit breaker and one dedicated Type A RCBO in the existing switchboard. Charger unit to be mounted on a brick wall using standard fixings. Testing and commissioning of the charger unit.
workingDetail: EV charger unit (7kW or 22kW), Dedicated circuit cable (6mm or 10mm TPS), Circuit breaker and RCD, Conduit and cable support
